content.comment_body: Dear users, I am using a [product_name] [article_no] with internet connectivity, and I'd like to link it to the database software [product_name] that we're running on our [product_name] control system at work, which is used to gather and archive process data. My question is: is it possible to collect data from [product_name] and display it in the database program? I found references to the VM function but I'm unsure how to proceed further. Could someone provide guidance on how I can achieve this? Thank you. [user_name]

Hello, I'm not familiar with [product_name] or [product_name] software. Generally, [product_name] [article_no] can exchange data with devices that support S7 communication protocol. You can develop a simple project in [product_name], such as an On-delay function. Set up a connection (as a [product_name] Server), use the VM-Mapping Table, and configure one parameter from the On-delay. The VM-Mapping Table displays the VM-Address for this variable. Download the configuration to [product_name], connect your PC, and attempt to read the VM-Address from the VM-Mapping Table. If you’re able to read it, communication with [product_name] is established. Alternatively, [product_name] can act as a client and read/write data to your PC. If these options do not work, you may need an OPC Server such as [product_name] to interface with [product_name]. Hope this helps.

Thank you for replying. [product_name] is the process control system used to operate our plant. [product_name] is a data logging application storing up to 10,000 process values. This was all pre-configured, so I don't know the technical details. The software is free for up to 25 parameters, which is more than sufficient for a [product_name] setup at home. My main challenge is understanding VM mapping. Currently, VM mapping works and I can access data on my mobile via the S7 Droide app. My question is—where does the data go on the network? In the future, I'd like to run data collection from a NAS that’s part of the network, so the application gathers and archives data for future reference. Thank you for any assistance. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are working to integrate a [product_name] module ([article_no]) with third-party database software through a [product_name] system for automated data collection. The central challenge lies in understanding and configuring the VM mapping function to enable data export and accessibility. Success was reported with reading data via a mobile app, but users are uncertain about data routing within their network and the potential setup for future NAS-based data storage.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek a straightforward solution to map and retrieve data from a [product_name] module into external database systems, with the ability to visualize process values and options for future expansion to network-attached storage for archiving.
